text: A system that answers HR, IT, and Ops questions is worthless if nobody can say whether its answers are actually right. This lesson plans how that gets judged -- before anything exists to judge.
Two different failure modes get tested separately: did retrieval find the right chunk, and is the generated answer actually grounded in it. Those are different bugs with different fixes.
The plan: a small labeled set of real questions from Priya's HR team, Omar's IT team, and the Ops team, each one paired with the document that should answer it.
First-pass scoring is manual review, by a person, reading retrieved chunks against generated answers. No eval set exists yet, and no numbers are claimed.
Next: planning who can see which documents, and how the system actually gets deployed and watched over time.
